title: Add semantic task routes and issue-creation dogfood

non_goals: Leave adjacent backlog or follow-on work out of this plan.

owned: Fill in the concrete files before implementation starts.

next_action: Fill in execution bounds, touched paths, and validation before implementation starts.

claims: Add semantic task routes and issue-creation dogfood is implemented, validated, and closed out honestly.
requirements: Fill in the narrowest command that proves the promoted work.

goal: Implement the #2930 shared agent-selected semantic task-route fact, migrate scoped instructions and specialized skills to consume it, consolidate remaining semantic applicability owners enough to satisfy the generic contract, and replay #2929 through the repo-owned issue procedure.
non_goals: Infer hard routes from task-text keywords or add a universal package-owned task taxonomy.
Let route selection grant mutation, network, publish, proof, review, policy, or completion authority.
Duplicate skill bodies, issue templates, Memory notes, or module semantics inside a route catalogue.

intent_continuity.larger intended outcome: Complete the 2026-09-01 dogfooding lane before resuming #2821-#2827.

execution_bounds.allowed paths: semantic route contracts/runtime/generated adapters; scoped instructions; canonical skill registries and skill recommendation; Memory/assurance/Verification consumers and tests where required; maintainer disposition docs; this plan/lane and release notes
execution_bounds.required validation commands: focused route/scoped-instruction/skill/Memory/Verification regressions; generated command conformance; workspace lint/typecheck; schema/reference checks; selected AW proof
execution_bounds.ask-before-refactor threshold: A new peer routing engine, persistent route history, universal taxonomy, or authority-bearing route semantics
execution_bounds.stop before touching: Unrelated #2821 implementation, unrelated archived planning state, provider-specific external mutation code, or portable module contracts that would become host-route dependent

completion_criteria: Repo-owned route identities are derived from canonical skill/capability declarations and progressively discoverable without full-tree startup output.
An agent can select selected/none/unresolved current-work-bound route facts with source-revision guards and stale invalidation.
Scoped Markdown and at least one independent consumer use the same fact and registered capability identities without lexical hard classification.
Exact/subtree/multiple/no-route/stale and non-GitHub fixtures pass while route facts remain authority-neutral.
The #2929 issue-creation replay surfaces shaping then creation procedure before external write and preserves template/helper ownership.
Older semantic marker consumers have implemented dispositions and the net semantic classifier surface is reduced, not merely documented.
